ab1.title: Locate the resonant source in the boundary defect
bullets: Every actual finite-volume equal-energy source block equals the corresponding block of the retained boundary defect.
The spectral diagonal is bounded by 70/543 of the source norm at the coupling cap; this does not show that it is zero.
The no-crossing boundary case has an exact local inverse. The general crossed inverse remains open.

ac1.title: Retain every old residual channel in 293 physical states
bullets: The enlarged space contains both shared-edge spin branches and reduces the full electric operator.
The forward calculation assembles 1088 exact magnetic matrix entries; the skeptic independently checks their Gram and old residual map.
Every old retained input has zero new omitted column. The all-input remainder is bounded by 20λ, and the all-time relative certificate is still worse than the earlier result.

ab2.title: Contract the full source at finite spectral resolution
bullets: A Gaussian strong integral constructs a bounded graph-preserving homological inverse with an explicit residual.
At duration s=4 the complete residual is at most 626/1629 of the original norm, uniformly over containing finite cuboids.
The boundary term is retained. Useful weighted locality and an exact inverse are still open.

ad1.title: Identify an elementary Wilson observable with a null slow endpoint
bullets: The yz and xy elementary cube plaquettes were evaluated separately with their own complete support collars.
Their averaged source is annihilated, and each phase-removed full canonical correlation tends to one.
This nonzero-variance Wilson observable detects no slow rate on the selected clock; six-cycle probes are selected next.

ac2.title: Control delayed loading and sharpen all-time heat accuracy
bullets: Both directions reconstruct the exact new magnetic matrix and its complete old-to-new coupling Gram.
The new channels start empty for the original input class. Their exact loading equation gives a sharper error integral without dropping their later contribution.
For every 0≤λ≤0.01, every time, and each normalized original P21 input within 0.01 of the vacuum, true-relative error is below 0.000037. The reverse certificate is below 0.000048.

ad2.title: Certify nontrivial endpoints for actual six-cycle Wilson observables
bullets: The prescribed X loop and coherent X/Y sum are actual multiplication operators, with complete supports, norms and conditional Haar moments.
Their vacuum-created vectors reach the proven sixteen-state reducing component, giving two exact endpoint laws and full finite-q error disks.
The finite-q witness disks exclude the null signal, but the sample time is 2e30 hbar/alpha. No experimental clock calibration or model equivalence follows.

ae1.title: Localize the Gaussian correction with all-time control
bullets: An interaction-picture path bound treats complete infinite-dimensional onsite factors and every crossing star. Integrating the whole Gaussian gives finite-collar errors uniform in containing volumes.

Forward: s=4, R=64 residual error below 2^-42 times the source norm on 374,660 factors. Reverse: s=2, R=40 residual error below 2e-7 and inverse error below 1e-7 on 74,088 factors, with a separate full commutator bound.
The resulting diameter-weighted decomposition is summable. Its support-cardinality upper budget fails; this does not prove the actual operator or all decompositions diverge.

equations.expression: poly(R)·2^(−R) is summable; exp[μ(R+2)³]·2^(−R) is a failed upper budget for μ>0

af1.title: Compute and certify the actual 293-coordinate heat vector
bullets: Both directions execute every retained coordinate at lambda=0.01, sigma=1 and vacuum input using exact rational arithmetic and the actual triplet metric.
The retained ground minimum is enclosed before centering; Taylor, center and coordinate-export errors are charged separately. The independent vector disks overlap in exact Gram norm.
The full-space point relative error is below 0.000015 forward and 0.000014 reverse. This point export is not an all-time evaluated trajectory.

ae2.title: Combine source contraction with the original support-size norm
bullets: A compact triangular filter with T=3 works on the disclosed smaller range M=7|tau|<=0.001. Every interior translated source retains all 12 crossing stars.
Each full source contracts below 0.7, and the inverse/residual families have finite rooted weight2 cardinality norms. Both directions derive complete ordered support sums.

The result is not contraction in the weighted norm. At the original cap, the known positive weighted certificates and contraction duration requirements have no overlap; actual divergence is not proved.

equations.label: AE2 · original-cap certificate obstruction
equations.expression: T>3328/789 for family contraction; T<26/105 for forward positive residual sum at M=35/1664

af2.title: Certify heat evaluation at every time on the original input class
bullets: At fixed lambda=0.01, an exact-arithmetic polynomial handles times through sigma=8; a separately certified ground-projector approximation handles all later times without accumulating ground-center error.

Uniform retained-vector numerical error is below 1e-8. Adding the complete AC2 physical budget and true denominator keeps full-space relative error below 0.000037 for normalized original P21 inputs within 0.01 of vacuum.

Forward exports 18 complete vectors including a complex nonvacuum preparation; reverse exports 12 real vectors and exposes a real-rational input/time CLI. Uniformity comes from operator estimates, not the exported samples.
